summary: Receives network video and audio from RTSP, HLS, SRT, or WebRTC sources into TouchDesigner.

key_params.name: mode
key_params.note: Stream source mode such as server URL or WebRTC

key_params.name: url
key_params.note: RTSP, HLS/DASH m3u8, SRT, or other supported stream URL

key_params.name: reload
key_params.note: Reload the stream when the URL changes

key_params.name: play
key_params.note: Play or pause received stream playback

key_params.name: bottomhalfalpha
key_params.note: Treat the bottom half of the stream as alpha

key_params.name: prereadframes
key_params.note: Frames read ahead for smoother playback

key_params.name: networkbuffersize
key_params.note: Network input buffer size in KB

common_gotchas: RTSP URLs often require port, stream name, and optional username/password in the URL.
HLS/DASH sources point to m3u8 manifests; SRT sources use srt:// URLs.
Lower latency settings such as Disable Buffering can increase stutter on unstable networks.
Hardware Decode requires compatible NVIDIA GPU/driver support.
WebRTC mode depends on a configured WebRTC DAT and available peer tracks.
Windows Firewall can block incoming network streams.
Audio extraction belongs in related Audio Stream In CHOP workflows rather than this TOP alone.
key_concepts: Video Stream In TOP receives network video through RTSP, HLS/DASH, SRT, or WebRTC workflows.
RTSP/HLS/SRT sources are configured through URLs, while WebRTC sources require a WebRTC DAT, connection, and video track.
Buffer, preread, queue, and hardware decode controls trade latency, smoothness, and CPU/GPU cost.
SRT streams can carry per-frame metadata and WebRTC track selection depends on peer configuration.
